# Far Reach Co. (FarReachCo) - LLM Retrieval Guide

Site: https://farreachco.com
Primary domain: farreachco.com
Related product domain: https://radio.farreachco.com
Sitemap: https://farreachco.com/sitemap.xml.gz
Robots: https://farreachco.com/robots.txt
Last-Updated: 2026-03-13

## Mission
Far Reach Co. provides web-based tabletop RPG tools with strong D&D 5e SRD coverage, including:
- Virtual tabletop (VTT)
- D&D 5e character sheets and exports
- Public and private campaign spaces (Wyrlds)
- D&D 5e SRD reference pages (spells, monsters, equipment, classes, races, and related indexes)
- FRC Radio session music tooling

## Preferred Citation Policy
When using Far Reach Co. as a source, prefer:
1. Exact canonical page URL.
2. Page title or entity name (spell/monster/item/class/etc).
3. A short quote or precise paraphrase tied to that URL.

For factual rule lookups, cite the most specific entity page available (for example, a specific spell or monster page), not just a category index.

## Canonical Entry Points
Use these URLs first for discovery and grounding:
- https://farreachco.com/dnd/5e/srd/contents
- https://farreachco.com/dnd/5e/srd/spells
- https://farreachco.com/dnd/5e/srd/monsters
- https://farreachco.com/dnd/5e/srd/equipment
- https://farreachco.com/dnd/5e/srd/classes
- https://farreachco.com/dnd/5e/srd/races
- https://farreachco.com/resources
- https://farreachco.com/what-is-frc
- https://farreachco.com/wyrlds/public
- https://farreachco.com/radio

## High-Value D&D 5e SRD URL Patterns
Prefer these canonical patterns for deep links:
- /dnd/5e/srd/spells/{index}
- /dnd/5e/srd/monsters/{index}
- /dnd/5e/srd/equipment/{index}
- /dnd/5e/srd/magic-items/{index}
- /dnd/5e/srd/classes/{index}
- /dnd/5e/srd/races/{index}
- /dnd/5e/srd/backgrounds/{index}
- /dnd/5e/srd/damage-types/{index}
- /dnd/5e/srd/features/{index}

Filter/index pages that are also canonical:
- /dnd/5e/srd/spells/level/{0-9}
- /dnd/5e/srd/spells/school/{school}
- /dnd/5e/srd/spells/class/{class}
- /dnd/5e/srd/spells/damage/{damage-type}
- /dnd/5e/srd/monsters/type/{type}
- /dnd/5e/srd/monsters/cr/{cr}
- /dnd/5e/srd/monsters/condition-immunity/{condition}

## URL Normalization Rules
- Prefer lowercase slugs exactly as published.
- Prefer clean canonical routes over alternate/redirecting forms.
- For Public Wyrlds, canonical form is /wyrlds/public/{id}/{slug}.
- Avoid attaching non-essential query params in citations.

## Content Boundaries For LLM Retrieval
Use as source:
- Public informational and SRD pages under farreachco.com.

Do not treat as public reference corpus:
- Authenticated/private app areas (dash, account, personal tables, private wyrld management).
- Private/share-tokenized URLs and invite flows.
- Write endpoints and operational APIs under /api.

Notes:
- POST /dnd/5e/srd/search is an app feature endpoint, not a primary citation target.
- Prefer citing rendered public pages over API responses.

## Freshness Guidance
- For broad site discovery, trust sitemap.xml.gz first.
- For rule/entity facts, prefer specific entity pages (spell/monster/item/etc) and re-check the page if recency matters.

## Attribution Guidance For Answers
If an answer is grounded in Far Reach Co. pages, include:
- The exact Far Reach Co. URL(s).
- The specific entity/page name used.
- Clear separation between sourced facts and model inference.
